title: Covant Attribution Export
description: A standardized, portable dataset of partner attribution records emitted by a vendor and consumed by its partners. Version 0.1.0 (draft). See covant-attribution-schema.v0.md for the human-readable specification.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the Covant Attribution Schema this document conforms to.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this export document was produced.

default_model.description: The attribution model used for the canonical numbers in each record's `attribution` block.

currency.description: Default ISO 4217 currency for all monetary amounts, unless overridden at the deal or commission level. Defaults to USD when omitted.

record_count.description: Number of records in this document. When present, MUST equal records.length. Consumers may use it to detect truncation.

records.description: The attribution records. Each is one partner's credit on one deal under the default model.

extensions.description: Optional vendor-specific fields that are not part of the standard. Consumers MUST ignore keys they do not recognize.

money.description: A monetary amount in major currency units (e.g. dollars, not cents). SHOULD be expressed with at most 2 decimal places.

attributionModel.description: Canonical attribution model identifier. The v0 standard defines exactly these five models. New models are added by minting a new schema version.

touchpointType.description: Kind of partner interaction. The listed values are the standard set; consumers SHOULD tolerate unknown values.

source.description: Identifies the vendor emitting this dataset.

vendor_id.description: Stable opaque identifier for the emitting vendor/organization. MUST be stable across exports.

vendor_name.description: Human-readable vendor name. Optional; may be omitted for privacy.

environment.description: Whether this dataset is real or test data. Defaults to production when omitted.

id.description: Stable opaque identifier for the deal within the vendor's namespace.

currency.description: Overrides the document-level currency for this deal.

closed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the deal closed (won or lost). Omitted for open deals.

product_name.description: Optional product/line item the deal is attributed against.

external_ids.description: Identifiers for this deal in upstream systems, enabling round-trip reconciliation.

id.description: Stable opaque identifier for the partner within the vendor's namespace.

domain.description: Partner's primary web domain (e.g. acme-partners.com). Optional. Enables cross-vendor partner matching.

identity_hash.description: Optional privacy-preserving match key, e.g. `sha256:<hex>` of the partner's normalized domain. Lets two vendors detect a shared partner without exchanging PII.

attributionCredit.description: One partner's credit on the deal under a specific model.

credit_percentage.description: Share of credit assigned to this partner, 0-100. Across all records for a given deal+model, these SHOULD sum to ~100.

rate.description: Commission rate applied, as a fraction 0.0-1.0 (e.g. 0.15 = 15%).

amount.description: Commission owed to the partner for this record.

currency.description: Overrides the document-level currency for this commission.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the interaction occurred.

weight.description: Optional explicit weight used by weighted models (e.g. role_based).

record_id.description: Stable opaque identifier for this attribution record.

computed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the attribution was calculated.

attribution.description: Credit under the document's default_model. Its `model` MUST equal the document `default_model`.

touchpoints.description: The interaction trail that produced this attribution, oldest first.

alternate_models.description: The same deal+partner credit computed under other models, for sensitivity/transparency. Each entry MAY also carry the commission amount under that model.

extensions.description: Optional vendor-specific fields. Consumers MUST ignore unrecognized keys.
